protocol.fold_assignment: folds are assigned by sorting subject ids and dealing round-robin (subject 1 -> fold 1, ..., subject 5 -> fold 5, subject 6 -> fold 1, ...). Deterministic, no shuffling, frozen here.  Fold sizes are 5,5,4,4,4
protocol.no_trial_split: a trial is one phase segment and belongs wholly to one subject, so trials can never be split across folds
protocol.no_subject_leakage: asserted at run time: the intersection of train and test subject sets is empty in every fold, and the union is all 22 subjects
protocol.normalization: TRAIN-FOLD ONLY z-scoring: mean and SD are computed on the training subjects of that fold and applied unchanged to the held-out subject.  A held-out subject is never normalized using its own statistics
protocol.primary_setting: zero-shot new-subject evaluation, no target-subject calibration

PRIMARY.A_LDA: LinearDiscriminantAnalysis(solver='lsqr', shrinkage='auto') on the train-fold z-scored features - the project's own frozen closed-set baseline configuration
PRIMARY.B_MULTINOMIAL_LR: LogisticRegression(multi_class='multinomial', solver='lbfgs', max_iter=2000, C=1.0) on the same features

model_configurations.no_hyperparameter_search: every model is used at ONE frozen configuration.  The point is task observability, not classifier innovation.  If simple models cannot read the signal, the task is not immediately rescued with a large model

notes: balanced accuracy is the primary metric
normalisation statistics come from the training folds only
feature_definition: at each centre frame t, a 40-feature local summary over the frozen primary window W frames: [pose(t), mean velocity over the window, pose(t + h) - pose(t - h) (net local change), per-channel SD of pose over the window], 10 features each

temporal_shuffle_control.scheme: reverse the frame order inside each window before computing the summary; the feature set and its marginal distribution are unchanged, only local temporal direction is destroyed

sensitivity_role: reported for completeness only; they may NOT be used to select the headline representation

matched_subset_comparison.why: R3's 500 ms centred window is defined only on frames at least 50 frames inside a trial, so the naive R3-vs-R1 comparison uses DIFFERENT FRAME SETS.  This block restricts every representation to the exact frame set where all of them are defined, which removes the confound.  It is the overlap set, not a post-hoc selection
matched_subset_comparison.note: the primary numbers in this artifact use the full INTERIOR stratum, which is valid for this representation; the matched block is the fair cross-representation comparison
